title: Red on Red

mood.label: On edge
mood.summary: On edge (43): Taiwan and Korea's markets plunged on AI-bubble fears, Russian strikes hit two embassies in Kyiv and outages grounded US flights. Against it: the ICJ found Myanmar guilty of genocide and Brazil recognised Indigenous land.

style.genre: half-time drum-and-bass — marimba, harp, pipe organ, Roland R-8

sampleSources: Strudel default library (VCSL marimba, harp, quiet pipe organ, tubular bells; Roland R-8 drum machine), sine-oscillator sub-bass

lines: Taipei down seven by the noon bell,
Seoul close behind it, red on red,
a debut meant to calm the room —
Glass on two embassy floors in Kyiv,
a Riyadh tower lit by fire,
the planes sat still when the screens went dark,
four brought home from the Senegal tide.
On edge, on edge — but The Hague said genocide out loud,
Brazil drew a line round the forest and its people,
a woman knocked on a noisy neighbour's door,
and strangers came by the hundred thousand.
